methodology: Option A: Independent Single-Set SSR for Six Constructs (Maier et al. adaptation)
embedding_notes: Local Ollama nomic-embed-text (768 dims) used instead of paper's OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536 dims) for 100% offline, local execution.

construct_responses.PE: This phone should be really fast, especially with the Snapdragon 8 Elite processor. The Hasselblad camera will be great for taking pro-level photos and videos, which I need for my photography club. I can handle multitasking easily with its powerful performance.
construct_responses.EE: Switching from iOS to Android might be a bit of a hassle, but the UI seems intuitive. The 2K AMOLED display will make a difference in how I perceive the phone, and the Hasselblad camera will definitely make taking pictures more fun and easier.
construct_responses.HM: The display and camera will be awesome for gaming and streaming videos. The high refresh rate and sharpness will make everything look super clear and smooth. The Hasselblad triple camera setup will be a game-changer for my photography hobby.
construct_responses.SI: My friends would be jealous of the build quality and camera, but most of them are on Android too. They might recommend it if they know I'm in the market for a new phone. Socially, it's a cool thing to have, but not a must-have for daily use.
construct_responses.PP: I don't worry much about data privacy, but with so many features, I'll feel safer knowing the phone has good on-device security. The build and camera are top-notch, so that's reassuring.
construct_responses.BI: I might consider buying it if I can get it on discount, but at ₹64,999, it's a bit steep for my budget. I'll probably hold onto my current iPhone for a bit longer.
construct_responses.OVERALL: The Apex Ultra Flagship 5G seems like a great phone, but the price is a bit high. I'd buy it if there's a good sale, but not right now.
